notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
Changes

New

 Improved touchscreen support. There is now an internal on-screen keyboard which can be optionally enabled.

 Contacts tab now lists all publishers met during Networking Events.

 SFX updates.
 Improved tutorial.
 Several bugfixes.
 Updated game engine.


macOS

 Rendering quality has been improved.


Linux

 Minimum OS requirement is now Ubuntu 18.04.

notes.title: Full Release - Leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
With the release of our latest v1.0.0 update, the game is reasonably stable to be made available to the general public. Therefore today we are excited to announce that Drafting Tales will be leaving Early Access!

Past

Drafting Tales was released on Steam Early Access in April 2019. We wanted to get the game to the players as soon as possible so that we receive feedback and feature requests to help us improve and polish the experience.

Those that have been with us from the very beginning, know that the game experience has changed quite a bit since our initial release. In v0.5.0, the game was playable for up to 5 years, there was only one home available, a single avatar and the gameplay was limited.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647395/3aaec4cca955b89b13fa64dca9eee2452b4e1439.png

Present

Fast-forward to v1.0.0, there are 3 homes available (apartment, house and mansion), 2 avatars to choose from, 2 possible endings in year 30 (good and bad), while you have the option to continue playing up to year 60. There are 13 milestones to complete, self-publishing (books and website), outlining for fiction works, sequels, multi-genre works, new items to purchase and new mechanics. Graphics, music and SFX have all been considerably improved. In addition, the game was made available for macOS after receiving many requests from players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647395/8e05b4dbb72bbf1ed64fc90b89852d5977bde4f5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647395/028f004eaa896e1b5c0d0fb91b72924cbf2c93b9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647395/6d18c6e70a9c60dd11503c6891eb360f5d355692.png

Future

Our plan is to keep adding features and updating the game as usual, however the stability of the game will become a priority.

We want to thank you all who bought Drafting Tales during Early Access and took the time to create videos, write reviews, provide us with valuable feedback, or email us just to tell us how much you loved the game. We hope that you keep enjoying the game and, as always, feel free to continue posting your feedback and suggestions.

-- The Drafting Tales Team

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.16.0)
notes.content:
Changes:

     Effort slots have been increased to 4. The outsource button has been removed, since it was rarely used and wasn't adding much to the game.
     [Community suggestion] There is now an auto-allocate button that will try to optimally allocate your available EP based on feedback history.
     Genre expertise has been increased to 4. It now counts towards work quality.
     At the end of each year, you will receive a report showing stats.
     Your books can become bestsellers.
     [Community suggestion] You can write sequels once your genre expertise is 4. Sequels have better chances of becoming bestsellers.
     You can now view your previously published books in the Character Dialog.
     The fans limit has been removed from the Mansion.
     Balancing improvements.
     Minor UI improvements.


You should be able to continue playing by loading a previous save. The first end of year report might not be accurate. If you run into other issues, it is recommended to start a new game.

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.15.0)
notes.content:
Changes:

 You can now buy a Mansion after year 18.
 Fixed a bug where the fans limit would fail to update after switching to a new home.

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.14.0)
notes.content:
Changes:

 You can now self-publish your books. You don't need an agent to self-publish and you get to keep all the profits, but you have to spend money on marketing and book printing. Self-publishing is unlocked by a book sometime after year 12.
 The book design dialog has been moved to the self-publishing flow. When publishing your books traditionally, you will receive a random book design.
 [Community suggestion] You can now query agents in the Character dialog. Hiring an agent costs 50XP. Better agents become available as the quality of your published works improves.
 Apartment: Your initial monthly expenses have been reduced to $600, but your rent will increase every year until you buy your own house.
 House: The fans limit has been increased to 500K.
 There's a new button on the book sales chart to withdraw your book from circulation early (in case it's not well received).
 New EP book: Plot
 Gameplay rebalancing: Your income will increase more gradually as the game progresses.
 Fixed an issue where old publisher offers would accumulate in the Mail dialog causing the game to crash.
 Fixed several issues with autosave.


You should be able to continue playing by loading a previous save. If you run into issues, it is recommended to start a new game.

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.13.0)
notes.content:
Changes:

 The reviews dialogs for both Articles and Short-Stories have been redesigned.
 You can now select which publishers to query. The probability of a query being successful depends on your work's quality and each publisher's audience reach score. Publishers will accept your work even if the genre/topic combo is not ideal.
 Reviews of previously published works can now be viewed in the Character dialog.
 The UI and slide-up notifications have been improved. 
 Fixed an issue where dialogs would not properly center on screen.


You should be able to continue playing by loading a previous save, but you won't be able to view previous reviews in the Character dialog. If you run into issues, it is recommended to start a new game.

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.12.0)
notes.content:
Changes:

 The task progress dialog was taking up too much space in smaller screens and has been redesigned to be more compact. The current task is now displayed at the bottom-right corner of the screen, just below the work queue.
 Character dialog: Fiction/non-fiction genres have been split into separate groups and are clearly marked.
 Work status dialog: The summary page has been redesigned.
 [Community suggestion] You can now keep working even if your Inspiration has dropped to zero, however you won’t be gaining any XP from writing and your writing speed will be slower until your Inspiration recovers.
 [Community suggestion] When reading Effort Point books, you will now slowly recover Inspiration at the Idle rate.
 [Community suggestion] Genres/topics in the Write dialog are sorted alphabetically.
 [Community suggestion] There's no need anymore to manually complete your work during the Revising stage. When your work reaches maximum clarity it will now auto-complete.
 [Community suggestion] Autosave is now enabled by default (triggers monthly and when quitting the game). It can be disabled in the options menu.
 [Community suggestion] The awards ceremony can be optionally skipped.

 The on-topic area at maximum Genre Expertise has been increased to 70% 


You should be able to continue by loading a v0.10.0 save. For all other versions, or if you run into issues, it is recommended to start a new game.

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.10.0)
notes.content:
Changes:

 New mechanic: Genre Expertise - determines how fast you reach maximum Clarity when writing. You can increase your Expertise by spending XP
 You don't have to buy the Market Report anymore and it is now accessible from the "Write" dialog. Audience demand for genres/topics is dynamic and depends on your recently published works
 You will now receive a message after unlocking each work type listing the minimum fan/quality requirements to publish (no more trial and error)
 The task progress dialog has been redesigned
 Your monthly expenses have been reduced to $900
 Balancing improvements
 Minor UI improvements
 Fixed an issue with some Nvidia cards


This update might break old saves. It is recommended to start a new game and enable the tutorial, which explains the new gameplay changes.

notes.title: Early Access Patch (v0.9.1)
notes.content:
Changes:

 Fixed a bug where the game would crash just before publishing Non-fiction/Novels
 The game engine should now have better compatibility with some graphics cards

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.9.0)
notes.content:
Changes:


 Visual improvements on the Write, Character, Work Status and Task progress dialogs
 When working on Freelance Jobs you will now receive a warning message a few days before the deadline
 When starting a new game the "Write" button will be initially disabled, until you get at least 1 additional Effort Slot
 Books awarding Effort Points now have different textures than Topic books
 Enabled tooltips for some icons (Money, XP, Fans, Inspiration)
 The "Query" button has been renamed to "Publish"
 Market Reports in the mail-order catalogue will display the year during which they are valid
 The game should now load considerably faster on older computers


This update should not break old saves, however if you run into issues you should try starting a new game.

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.8.0)
notes.content:
Changes:


 Effort points have been re-balanced for all genres
 4 new items available to purchase
 Inspiration now recovers much faster when your character is idle
 You now lose less fans when publishing an Article/Short-Story with bad reviews
 XP is generated at a slightly slower rate than before during the first few years
 You will now receive a mail message telling you how many fans you need to acquire before starting to get offers from Agents


This update should not break old saves, however if you run into issues you should try starting a new game.

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.7.0)
notes.content:
Changes:

 Major update to the game engine
 There is an option now allowing you to continue playing the game beyond year 6 and up to 30 game years, which is the same limit planned for the final release. Please note that beyond year 6 the game has not been well tested, certain features are not currently available and the experience might not be representative of what we are planning for the final release.


This update should not break old saves.

notes.title: Early Access Update (v0.6.0)
notes.content:
You can now spend XP to boost your Inspiration
 Modified the Vacation item to appear earlier in the game
 When writing new genre/topic combos you now get reduced Inspiration drop as a bonus (-20%)
 The game is now playable for up to 6 game years (+1 year)
 Minor GUI changes

notes.title: Early Access Patch (v0.5.1)
notes.content: Fixes resizing issues in Windows when fonts and application scaling is greater than 100%
